exposure: antenatal diet and physical activity intervention
outcome: childhood adiposity (body mass index, skinfold thicknesses, body fat, waist and arm circumferences)
cohort: Mother-child dyads from an initial trial of 1555 pregnant women with obesity, with 514 of their three-year-old children attending the follow-up appointment.
finding: An antenatal dietary and physical activity intervention in women with obesity was associated with a lower offspring pulse rate and sustained improvements in maternal diet 3-years postpartum.
